name: old-choral-hall

building.title: Old Choral Hall, University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 104's outline from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; used only to choose the crop box, to pick the building's own points (frame.near_outline) and to draw on the heightmap figure; the frame comes from the LiDAR.

origin.note: the campus origin, as in campus.json; the landmark's local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, with grid north

door.note: view frame: on the Symonds Street footpath at the mouth of the forecourt between the corner pavilion and the north-east block, where the LiDAR ground is 37.78 m (median within 1 m), the model's y = 0 at 37.7; the doors themselves are behind the works' hoarding in every panorama of the street front; place.py puts it on the map

lidar.licence: Auckland Part 1 LiDAR (2024), OpenTopography NZ24_Auckland, doi:10.5069/G9HH6H8T: sourced from LINZ and licensed by Regional Software Holdings Limited for re-use under CC BY 4.0

aerial.licence: Auckland Central 0.06 m Urban Aerial Photos (2023): sourced from LINZ and licensed by Auckland Council for re-use under CC BY 4.0

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) within near_outline m of building 104 outline: centre = mean x/y of points higher than tower_above m; axis = the bearing of most of the walls seen from above (axis_from walls: the building is wings at two angles, so the principal axis falls between them), the one of the two square to each other nearest the principal axis; toStreet = the axis turned 90 deg toward street_side: south-east, to Symonds Street.

streetview.pano_ids_note: eleven of the twelve nearest of Google's own panoramas (copyright Google) within radius_m: six on Symonds Street in front (2024-08, the works: scaffolds and white wraps), three off the south-west range (2022-09, before the works), one across the corner (2024-10) and one behind on the north-west (2025-05, the works); the twelfth, BCtN4La4k0spbkhYMtiWyA (undated, 13,312 px wide), is a panorama inside a cafe, not of the building, and is left out (its 99 tiles were bought before it was looked at); user-contributed panoramas are left out

light.note: the viewer's light for this building (pipeline/viewer/main.js; the address still wins): the sun of the 2022-09 panoramas of the south-west range, seen in nAxE at bearing about 41.5 deg and 48 deg up (late morning), so the range's south-west face is in open shade under a bright hazy sky; the other numbers start from Old Government House's

ground_note: the LiDAR ground at the door (37.78 m, within 1 m) and in the middle of the street front; the Symonds Street footpath falls from 38.5 m at the corner pavilion (x -18) to 36.85 m at the north-east corner, and the south-west footpath rises from 38.7 m at the corner to 40.6 m at the back pavilion (parts/common.js GROUND)
